Context: 21. Ex gratia Pension/Family Pension to CPF Retirees

Central Government employees who had rendered not less than 20 years of continuous service and retired with CPF benefits during the period from 18th November, 1960 to 31st December, 1985 are also eligible for the grant of ex gratia pension at the rate of~ 600 p.m. from 1-11-1997.  
All CPF beneficiaries who retired voluntarily or on medical invalidation before 1-1-1986 after completing 20 years of continuous service are also eligible for grant of ex gratia payment. - OM, dated 26-6-2013.
